title: Stratégie Mondiale de lutte contre le SIDA

sections.title: Front matter

summary.text: A French-language Executive Board resolution (EB89.R19, January 1992) on the global AIDS strategy, which thanks the Director-General for his report and notes WHO's leadership, its support to national programmes and wider UN mobilization. It recommends a resolution to the Forty-fifth World Health Assembly recalling earlier Assembly and UN General Assembly resolutions on AIDS.

sections.extract: Quatre-vingt-neuvième session EB89.R19 Point 12 de l'ordre du jour 28 janvier 1992 STRATEGIE MONDIALE DE LUTTE CONTRE LE SIDA Le Conseil exécutif, Ayant examiné le rapport du Directeur général sur la stratégie mondiale de lutte contre le SIDA et le document contenant un projet de mise à jour de cette stratégie;1 1. REMERCIE le Directeur général de son rapport et le félicite de la qualité technique et de la diversité

sections.title: Page 2

summary.text: Continues the French AIDS resolution, voicing concern at the pandemic's fast spread in developing countries and some urban areas and stating that public health concerns cannot justify measures, such as mandatory screening, that violate individual rights. It endorses the 1992 update of the global strategy, which adds emphasis on treating other sexually transmitted diseases, improving the status of women and creating a supportive social environment. It closes with requests to fight discrimination and support national laws protecting the rights of people with HIV.
